questions.q: According to Matthew 27:57-61, who went to Pontius Pilate to request the body of Jesus for burial?
questions.explain: When it was evening, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who also was a disciple of Jesus. He went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
